name: Outline Lettering
description: Large outlined lettering that draws itself in, and whose outline lights up in colour around the pointer.

props.name: text
props.description: The lettering. It is scaled to fit the box and exposed to assistive tech as plain text.

props.name: strokeWidth
props.description: Width of the hairline outline, in screen pixels at any size. The coloured outline is a little heavier.

props.name: radius
props.description: Radius of the lit circle around the pointer, as a fraction of the text width.

props.name: colors
props.description: Colours of the lit outline, blended along the word from left to right. Any CSS colour or token. The defaults deepen a little on light backgrounds.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds the outline takes to draw itself the first time it comes into view. Under reduced motion it is shown at once.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, a block as wide as its container. Font family, weight and tracking are inherited by the lettering. Other div props are passed through.
